page.layout: One page of verse, one column; running head at top centre; a catchword "Terra" at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p:
Oportet, hàsque ferre sarcinas, iter
Trium est dierum ad Sfque mentium iuga.
Queis me tremendus imperauit Sustimas
Mactare sibi totius orbis Arbiter.
main_text.head: PASTORES.
main_text.p:
Tuum est iubere quae Soles, nostrum obsequi.
Quocunque nos duces, sequemur ocyus.
main_text.head: ABRAHAMVS.

p.i:
Eamus igitur quo Deus Vocat. Tibi
Absentibus nobis domus custodiam
Commendo, coniux, meque sospitem breui
Spera reuersurum fauente Numinis
Almi benignitate, quam toties sumus
Experti Sterque, quando durioribus
Nostram probauit ante casibus fidem.

main_text.head: SARA.

p.i:
Domi manens Superos precabor, Sut tuis
Faustum Selint donare coeptis exitum,
Cunctisque seruatum periclis reddere
Cum dulci Isaco coniugem charum mihi.

main_text.head: Sathanas.

p.i:
Sic ergo nullis artibus necnamachinis
Tam pertinax istius expugnabitur
Fides senis? Nostrisne semper fortior
Conatibus resistet, abnuens dare
Victas manus? Subacta gens mortalium
Nostris Sbique legibus paret, neque

page.notes: Catchword "Terra" at lower right. Some printed marks and ornaments in margins (small scribbles, a bracket at lower left) are not text. Italic lines transcribed as italic; "Sathanas" set as a speaker name, kept as a paragraph-level head. Some words uncertain in long-s/f forms (e.g. "Sustimas", "Sut", "Sbique") are as read; "necnamachinis" appears as printed (possibly "necnon machinis").
